title: Send JSON data
summary: Phoenix: Send JSON data. Add a page count.
introduction: json turns an Elixir map into a JSON reply. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Send JSON data
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/book", LessonController, :book
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def book(conn, _params), do: json(conn, %{title: "Moon Trip"})
end

blocks.text: json turns the atom-keyed map into a JSON object.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A map holds named data; its field order is not important.
